Q1a.en: The function is not one-one: \(f(-1) = |-1| = 1 = f(1)\) although \(-1 \neq 1\), so f is many-one. Here \(\mathrm{R}^{+}\) is taken, as in NCERT, to be the set of all non-negative real numbers. Every \(y \geq 0\) then has the pre-image \(x = y\), because \(f(y) = |y| = y\), so f is onto. Hence f is many-one and onto, which is the choice many-one and onto.
Q1a.hi: यह फलन एकैकी नहीं है: \(f(-1) = |-1| = 1 = f(1)\) जबकि \(-1 \neq 1\), अतः f बहु-एकैकी है। यहाँ NCERT की भाँति \(\mathrm{R}^{+}\) को सभी ऋणेतर वास्तविक संख्याओं का समुच्चय माना गया है। तब प्रत्येक \(y \geq 0\) का पूर्व-प्रतिबिंब \(x = y\) है, क्योंकि \(f(y) = |y| = y\), अतः f आच्छादक है। इसलिए f बहु-एकैकी और आच्छादक है, जो विकल्प बहु-एकैकी और आच्छादक है।

Q1b.en:
A pair \((a, b)\) is in R when \(a = b - 1\) and \(b \geq 3\). For \((4, 5)\): \(5 - 1 = 4\) and \(5 \geq 3\), so \((4, 5) \in \mathrm{R}\). The other pairs fail, since \(4 - 1 = 3 
eq 2\), \(6 - 1 = 5 
eq 4\) and \(3 - 1 = 2 
eq 1\). So the answer is the choice \((4, 5) \in \mathrm{R}\).

Q1c.en: Writing \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\), let \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\cos x} + \sqrt{\sin x}}\,dx\). By the property \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\,dx\), \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x} + \sqrt{\cos x}}\,dx\). Adding the two forms, \(2I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} 1\,dx = \frac{\pi}{2}\), so \(I = \frac{\pi}{4}\), which is the choice \(\frac{\pi}{4}\).
Q1c.hi: \(\tan x = \frac{\sin x}{\cos x}\) लिखने पर, माना \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sqrt{\cos x}}{\sqrt{\cos x} + \sqrt{\sin x}}\,dx\)। गुणधर्म \(\int_{0}^{a} f(x)\,dx = \int_{0}^{a} f(a - x)\,dx\) से \(I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} \frac{\sqrt{\sin x}}{\sqrt{\sin x} + \sqrt{\cos x}}\,dx\)। दोनों को जोड़ने पर \(2I = \int_{0}^{\pi/2} 1\,dx = \frac{\pi}{2}\), अतः \(I = \frac{\pi}{4}\), जो विकल्प \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) है।

Q1d.en: To make the equation a polynomial in the derivatives, cube both sides: \(729\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 = 1 + \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)^2\). The highest order derivative \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\) now occurs with power 3, so the degree is 3, which is the choice 3.
Q1d.hi: समीकरण को अवकलजों में बहुपद बनाने के लिए दोनों पक्षों का घन करने पर: \(729\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 = 1 + \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)^2\)। अब उच्चतम कोटि के अवकलज \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\) की घात 3 है, अतः घात 3 है, जो विकल्प 3 है।

Q1e.en: For the unit vectors, \(\hat{i} \cdot \hat{i} = 1\), \(\hat{j} \cdot \hat{j} = 1\) and \(\hat{k} \times \hat{k} = \vec{0}\) (the cross product of a vector with itself is zero). So the expression equals \(1 - 1 + 0 = 0\), which is the choice 0.
Q1e.hi: मात्रक सदिशों के लिए \(\hat{i} \cdot \hat{i} = 1\), \(\hat{j} \cdot \hat{j} = 1\) तथा \(\hat{k} \times \hat{k} = \vec{0}\) (किसी सदिश का स्वयं से सदिश गुणनफल शून्य होता है)। अतः व्यंजक का मान \(1 - 1 + 0 = 0\) है, जो विकल्प 0 है।

Q2a.en:
Put \(x = \sec\theta\), where \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\) since \(x > 1\). Then \(\sqrt{x^2 - 1} = \sqrt{\sec^2\theta - 1} = \tan\theta\), so
\(\cot^{-1}\left\{\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}\right\} = \cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta}\right) = \cot^{-1}(\cot\theta) = \theta = \sec^{-1}x\).
The simplest form is \(\sec^{-1}x\) (equivalently \(\tan^{-1}\sqrt{x^2 - 1}\)).
Q2a.hi:
माना \(x = \sec\theta\), जहाँ \(x > 1\) होने से \(0 < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\)। तब \(\sqrt{x^2 - 1} = \sqrt{\sec^2\theta - 1} = \tan\theta\), अतः
\(\cot^{-1}\left\{\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2 - 1}}\right\} = \cot^{-1}\left(\frac{1}{\tan\theta}\right) = \cot^{-1}(\cot\theta) = \theta = \sec^{-1}x\)।
सरलतम रूप \(\sec^{-1}x\) है (समतुल्य रूप \(\tan^{-1}\sqrt{x^2 - 1}\))।

Q2b.en:
Here \(f(0) = |0| = 0\).
Left hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 0^-} |x| = \lim_{x \to 0^-} (-x) = 0\).
Right hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 0^+} |x| = \lim_{x \to 0^+} x = 0\).
Since left hand limit = right hand limit = \(f(0) = 0\), the function \(f(x) = |x|\) is continuous at \(x = 0\).

Q2c.en: The equation is a polynomial in the derivatives. Its highest order derivative is \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\) (order 2), and this derivative occurs with power 1. So the degree of the differential equation is 1.
Q2c.hi: यह समीकरण अवकलजों में बहुपद है। इसका उच्चतम कोटि का अवकलज \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\) (कोटि 2) है, और इसकी घात 1 है। अतः अवकल समीकरण की घात 1 है।

Q2d.en:
By the multiplication theorem of probability,
\(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B/A) = 0.12 \times 0.18 = 0.0216\).
Q2d.hi:
प्रायिकता के गुणन प्रमेय से,
\(P(A \cap B) = P(A) \cdot P(B/A) = 0.12 \times 0.18 = 0.0216\)।

Q2e.en:
Let \(\vec{a} = -2\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\). Then \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = -6 - 2 + 3 = -5\), \(|\vec{a}| = \sqrt{4 + 1 + 9} = \sqrt{14}\) and \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{9 + 4 + 1} = \sqrt{14}\).
So \(\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|} = \frac{-5}{14}\), and the angle is \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{5}{14}\right)\).
Q2e.hi:
माना \(\vec{a} = -2\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 3\hat{k}\) तथा \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\)। तब \(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} = -6 - 2 + 3 = -5\), \(|\vec{a}| = \sqrt{4 + 1 + 9} = \sqrt{14}\) तथा \(|\vec{b}| = \sqrt{9 + 4 + 1} = \sqrt{14}\)।
अतः \(\cos\theta = \frac{\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b}}{|\vec{a}||\vec{b}|} = \frac{-5}{14}\), और अभीष्ट कोण \(\theta = \cos^{-1}\left(-\frac{5}{14}\right)\) है।

Q3a.en:
\((gof)(x) = g(f(x)) = g(\cos x) = 3\cos^2 x\).
\((fog)(x) = f(g(x)) = f(3x^2) = \cos(3x^2)\).
These are different functions. For example, at \(x = 0\): \((gof)(0) = 3\cos^2 0 = 3\) but \((fog)(0) = \cos 0 = 1\). Since \(3 \neq 1\), \(gof \neq fog\).

Q3b.en:
Write the equation as a linear equation in x: \(y\frac{dx}{dy} + x = y^2\), that is \(\frac{dx}{dy} + \frac{1}{y}x = y\).
This is of the form \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1\) with \(P_1 = \frac{1}{y}\), \(Q_1 = y\).
Integrating factor: \(e^{\int \frac{1}{y}dy} = e^{\log y} = y\).
So the solution is \(x \cdot y = \int y \cdot y\,dy = \int y^2\,dy = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\).
General solution: \(xy = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\).
Q3b.hi:
समीकरण को x में रैखिक रूप में लिखने पर: \(y\frac{dx}{dy} + x = y^2\), अर्थात् \(\frac{dx}{dy} + \frac{1}{y}x = y\)।
यह \(\frac{dx}{dy} + P_1 x = Q_1\) के रूप का है, जहाँ \(P_1 = \frac{1}{y}\), \(Q_1 = y\)।
समाकलन गुणक: \(e^{\int \frac{1}{y}dy} = e^{\log y} = y\)।
अतः हल \(x \cdot y = \int y \cdot y\,dy = \int y^2\,dy = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\)।
व्यापक हल: \(xy = \frac{y^3}{3} + C\)।

Q3c.en:
Let the points be P(4, 4, 2), Q(3, 5, 2) and R(-1, -1, 2).
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} = (3 - 4)\hat{i} + (5 - 4)\hat{j} + (2 - 2)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} + \hat{j}\)
\(\overrightarrow{PR} = (-1 - 4)\hat{i} + (-1 - 4)\hat{j} + (2 - 2)\hat{k} = -5\hat{i} - 5\hat{j}\)
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} \cdot \overrightarrow{PR} = (-1)(-5) + (1)(-5) + 0 = 5 - 5 = 0\).
So \(\overrightarrow{PQ} \perp \overrightarrow{PR}\), and the angle at P is \(90^\circ\). (Check by lengths: \(PQ^2 = 2\), \(PR^2 = 50\), \(QR^2 = 16 + 36 = 52 = PQ^2 + PR^2\).) Hence the three points are the vertices of a right angled triangle.
Q3c.hi:
माना बिंदु P(4, 4, 2), Q(3, 5, 2) तथा R(-1, -1, 2) हैं।
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} = (3 - 4)\hat{i} + (5 - 4)\hat{j} + (2 - 2)\hat{k} = -\hat{i} + \hat{j}\)
\(\overrightarrow{PR} = (-1 - 4)\hat{i} + (-1 - 4)\hat{j} + (2 - 2)\hat{k} = -5\hat{i} - 5\hat{j}\)
\(\overrightarrow{PQ} \cdot \overrightarrow{PR} = (-1)(-5) + (1)(-5) + 0 = 5 - 5 = 0\)।
अतः \(\overrightarrow{PQ} \perp \overrightarrow{PR}\), और P पर कोण \(90^\circ\) है। (लंबाइयों से जाँच: \(PQ^2 = 2\), \(PR^2 = 50\), \(QR^2 = 16 + 36 = 52 = PQ^2 + PR^2\)।) अतः तीनों बिंदु एक समकोण त्रिभुज के शीर्ष हैं।

Q3d.en:
Equal matrices have equal corresponding elements, so
\(x + y = 6\), \(5 + z = 5\) and \(xy = 8\).
From \(5 + z = 5\), \(z = 0\).
x and y are the roots of \(t^2 - 6t + 8 = 0\), that is \((t - 2)(t - 4) = 0\), so \(t = 2\) or \(4\).
Hence \(x = 2, y = 4, z = 0\) or \(x = 4, y = 2, z = 0\).

Q4a.en:
\(f(x) = 7x^2 - 3\), so \(f'(x) = 14x\).
For \(x > 0\), \(14x > 0\), that is \(f'(x) > 0\).
Hence f is an increasing function when \(x > 0\), that is on \((0, \infty)\).

Q4b.en:
\(\vec{a} + \vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 4\hat{k}\) and \(\vec{a} - \vec{b} = 0\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\).
A vector perpendicular to both is
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \times (\vec{a} - \vec{b}) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-6 + 4) - \hat{j}(-4 - 0) + \hat{k}(-2 - 0) = -2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\).
Its magnitude is \(\sqrt{4 + 16 + 4} = \sqrt{24} = 2\sqrt{6}\).
So the required unit vector is \(\pm\frac{-2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}}{2\sqrt{6}} = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}(-\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - \hat{k})\).
Q4b.hi:
\(\vec{a} + \vec{b} = 2\hat{i} + 3\hat{j} + 4\hat{k}\) तथा \(\vec{a} - \vec{b} = 0\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\)।
दोनों पर लंबवत सदिश
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b}) \times (\vec{a} - \vec{b}) = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & 3 & 4 \\ 0 & -1 & -2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-6 + 4) - \hat{j}(-4 - 0) + \hat{k}(-2 - 0) = -2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}\)।
इसका परिमाण \(\sqrt{4 + 16 + 4} = \sqrt{24} = 2\sqrt{6}\) है।
अतः अभीष्ट मात्रक सदिश \(\pm\frac{-2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 2\hat{k}}{2\sqrt{6}} = \pm\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}(-\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - \hat{k})\) है।

Q4c.en:
Comparing with \(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\), the line passes through the point \((5, -4, 6)\) and is parallel to the vector \(3\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\).
So \(\vec{a} = 5\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), and the vector equation \(\vec{r} = \vec{a} + \lambda\vec{b}\) is
\(\vec{r} = (5\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}) + \lambda(3\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\).
Q4c.hi:
\(\frac{x - x_1}{a} = \frac{y - y_1}{b} = \frac{z - z_1}{c}\) से तुलना करने पर, रेखा बिंदु \((5, -4, 6)\) से होकर जाती है और सदिश \(3\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\) के समांतर है।
अतः \(\vec{a} = 5\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = 3\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\), और सदिश समीकरण \(\vec{r} = \vec{a} + \lambda\vec{b}\) है:
\(\vec{r} = (5\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} + 6\hat{k}) + \lambda(3\hat{i} + 7\hat{j} + 2\hat{k})\)।

Q4d.en:
The draws from the two bags are independent events.
First bag: 4 white + 2 black = 6 balls, so \(P(\text{black}) = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\).
Second bag: 3 white + 5 black = 8 balls, so \(P(\text{black}) = \frac{5}{8}\).
P(both black) \(= \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{5}{8} = \frac{5}{24}\).
Q4d.hi:
दोनों थैलों से गेंद निकालना स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं।
पहला थैला: 4 सफेद + 2 काली = 6 गेंद, अतः \(P(\text{काली}) = \frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3}\)।
दूसरा थैला: 3 सफेद + 5 काली = 8 गेंद, अतः \(P(\text{काली}) = \frac{5}{8}\)।
दोनों गेंद काली होने की प्रायिकता \(= \frac{1}{3} \times \frac{5}{8} = \frac{5}{24}\)।

Q5a.en:
\(\mathrm{R}_1\) and \(\mathrm{R}_2\) are equivalence relations on the set A, so each is reflexive, symmetric and transitive. We check the three properties for \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\).
(i) Reflexive: for every \(a \in A\), \((a, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1\) and \((a, a) \in \mathrm{R}_2\), since both are reflexive. Hence \((a, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\), so \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) is reflexive.
(ii) Symmetric: let \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\). Then \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_1\) and \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_2\). As both are symmetric, \((b, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1\) and \((b, a) \in \mathrm{R}_2\), so \((b, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\). Hence \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) is symmetric.
(iii) Transitive: let \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) and \((b, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\). Then \((a, b), (b, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1\), and since \(\mathrm{R}_1\) is transitive, \((a, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1\). Likewise \((a, b), (b, c) \in \mathrm{R}_2\) gives \((a, c) \in \mathrm{R}_2\). So \((a, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\), and \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) is transitive.
Being reflexive, symmetric and transitive, \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) is an equivalence relation on the set A.
Q5a.hi:
\(\mathrm{R}_1\) तथा \(\mathrm{R}_2\) समुच्चय A में तुल्यता संबंध हैं, अतः प्रत्येक स्वतुल्य, सममित तथा संक्रामक है। अब \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) के लिए तीनों गुणों की जाँच करते हैं।
(i) स्वतुल्य: प्रत्येक \(a \in A\) के लिए \((a, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1\) तथा \((a, a) \in \mathrm{R}_2\), क्योंकि दोनों स्वतुल्य हैं। अतः \((a, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\), अर्थात् \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) स्वतुल्य है।
(ii) सममित: माना \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\)। तब \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_1\) तथा \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_2\)। दोनों सममित होने से \((b, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1\) तथा \((b, a) \in \mathrm{R}_2\), अतः \((b, a) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\)। अतः \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) सममित है।
(iii) संक्रामक: माना \((a, b) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) तथा \((b, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\)। तब \((a, b), (b, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1\), और \(\mathrm{R}_1\) संक्रामक होने से \((a, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1\)। इसी प्रकार \((a, b), (b, c) \in \mathrm{R}_2\) से \((a, c) \in \mathrm{R}_2\)। अतः \((a, c) \in \mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\), अर्थात् \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) संक्रामक है।
स्वतुल्य, सममित तथा संक्रामक होने के कारण \(\mathrm{R}_1 \cap \mathrm{R}_2\) समुच्चय A में एक तुल्यता संबंध है।

Q5b.en:
Let \(t = \tan\frac{\alpha}{2}\). Then \(\cos\alpha = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\) and \(\sin\alpha = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}\).
With the identity matrix I of order 2,
\(I + A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -t \\ t & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(I - A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & t \\ -t & 1 \end{bmatrix}\).
Right hand side:
\((I - A)\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha + t\sin\alpha & -\sin\alpha + t\cos\alpha \\ -t\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha & t\sin\alpha + \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\).
Now each entry:
\(\cos\alpha + t\sin\alpha = \frac{1 - t^2 + 2t^2}{1 + t^2} = \frac{1 + t^2}{1 + t^2} = 1\)
\(-\sin\alpha + t\cos\alpha = \frac{-2t + t - t^3}{1 + t^2} = \frac{-t(1 + t^2)}{1 + t^2} = -t\)
\(-t\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha = \frac{-t + t^3 + 2t}{1 + t^2} = \frac{t(1 + t^2)}{1 + t^2} = t\)
\(t\sin\alpha + \cos\alpha = 1\) (as in the first entry).
So the right hand side \(= \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -t \\ t & 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -\tan\frac{\alpha}{2} \\ \tan\frac{\alpha}{2} & 1 \end{bmatrix} = I + A\).
Hence \((I + A) = (I - A)\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\).
Q5b.hi:
माना \(t = \tan\frac{\alpha}{2}\)। तब \(\cos\alpha = \frac{1 - t^2}{1 + t^2}\) तथा \(\sin\alpha = \frac{2t}{1 + t^2}\)।
कोटि 2 के तत्समक आव्यूह I के साथ,
\(I + A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -t \\ t & 1 \end{bmatrix}\), \(I - A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & t \\ -t & 1 \end{bmatrix}\)।
दायाँ पक्ष:
\((I - A)\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha + t\sin\alpha & -\sin\alpha + t\cos\alpha \\ -t\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha & t\sin\alpha + \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\)।
अब प्रत्येक अवयव:
\(\cos\alpha + t\sin\alpha = \frac{1 - t^2 + 2t^2}{1 + t^2} = \frac{1 + t^2}{1 + t^2} = 1\)
\(-\sin\alpha + t\cos\alpha = \frac{-2t + t - t^3}{1 + t^2} = \frac{-t(1 + t^2)}{1 + t^2} = -t\)
\(-t\cos\alpha + \sin\alpha = \frac{-t + t^3 + 2t}{1 + t^2} = \frac{t(1 + t^2)}{1 + t^2} = t\)
\(t\sin\alpha + \cos\alpha = 1\) (पहले अवयव की भाँति)।
अतः दायाँ पक्ष \(= \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -t \\ t & 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -\tan\frac{\alpha}{2} \\ \tan\frac{\alpha}{2} & 1 \end{bmatrix} = I + A\)।
अतः \((I + A) = (I - A)\begin{bmatrix} \cos\alpha & -\sin\alpha \\ \sin\alpha & \cos\alpha \end{bmatrix}\)।

Q5c.en:
Let \(y = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos x}\right)\).
Using \(\sin x = 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}\) and \(1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}\),
\(\frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos x} = \frac{2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}} = \tan\frac{x}{2}\).
So \(y = \tan^{-1}\left(\tan\frac{x}{2}\right) = \frac{x}{2}\), for \(-\pi < x < \pi\) (so that \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \frac{x}{2} < \frac{\pi}{2}\)).
Differentiating with respect to x:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{2}\).
Q5c.hi:
माना \(y = \tan^{-1}\left(\frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos x}\right)\)।
\(\sin x = 2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}\) तथा \(1 + \cos x = 2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}\) से,
\(\frac{\sin x}{1 + \cos x} = \frac{2\sin\frac{x}{2}\cos\frac{x}{2}}{2\cos^2\frac{x}{2}} = \tan\frac{x}{2}\)।
अतः \(y = \tan^{-1}\left(\tan\frac{x}{2}\right) = \frac{x}{2}\), जहाँ \(-\pi < x < \pi\) (जिससे \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \frac{x}{2} < \frac{\pi}{2}\))।
x के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर:
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{2}\)।

Q5d.en:
Compare with \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) and \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\):
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\).
Shortest distance \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\).
\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 0\hat{j} - \hat{k}\).
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 - 1) - \hat{j}(4 - 3) + \hat{k}(2 + 3) = -3\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\).
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 25} = \sqrt{35}\).
\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-3)(1) + (-1)(0) + (5)(-1) = -8\).
So \(d = \left|\frac{-8}{\sqrt{35}}\right| = \frac{8}{\sqrt{35}}\) units.
Q5d.hi:
\(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_1 + \lambda\vec{b}_1\) तथा \(\vec{r} = \vec{a}_2 + \mu\vec{b}_2\) से तुलना करने पर:
\(\vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + \hat{j}\), \(\vec{b}_1 = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\), \(\vec{a}_2 = 2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \hat{k}\), \(\vec{b}_2 = 3\hat{i} + \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}\)।
न्यूनतम दूरी \(d = \left|\frac{(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1)}{|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2|}\right|\)।
\(\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1 = \hat{i} + 0\hat{j} - \hat{k}\)।
\(\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2 = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 3 & 1 & 2 \end{vmatrix} = \hat{i}(-2 - 1) - \hat{j}(4 - 3) + \hat{k}(2 + 3) = -3\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 5\hat{k}\)।
\(|\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2| = \sqrt{9 + 1 + 25} = \sqrt{35}\)।
\((\vec{b}_1 \times \vec{b}_2) \cdot (\vec{a}_2 - \vec{a}_1) = (-3)(1) + (-1)(0) + (5)(-1) = -8\)।
अतः \(d = \left|\frac{-8}{\sqrt{35}}\right| = \frac{8}{\sqrt{35}}\) मात्रक।

Q5e.en:
\(y = e^{\tan^{-1}x}\). Differentiating with respect to x,
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{\tan^{-1}x} \cdot \frac{1}{1 + x^2} = \frac{y}{1 + x^2}\),
so \((1 + x^2)\frac{dy}{dx} = y\).
Differentiating again with respect to x (product rule on the left),
\((1 + x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 2x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{dx}\).
Taking all terms to the left,
\((1 + x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + (2x - 1)\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\).
Hence proved.
Q5e.hi:
\(y = e^{\tan^{-1}x}\)। x के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर,
\(\frac{dy}{dx} = e^{\tan^{-1}x} \cdot \frac{1}{1 + x^2} = \frac{y}{1 + x^2}\),
अतः \((1 + x^2)\frac{dy}{dx} = y\)।
पुनः x के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर (बाएँ पक्ष में गुणनफल नियम से),
\((1 + x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + 2x\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{dx}\)।
सभी पदों को बाईं ओर ले जाने पर,
\((1 + x^2)\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + (2x - 1)\frac{dy}{dx} = 0\)।
इति सिद्धम्।

Q6a.en:
Continuity at \(x = -1\):
\(f(-1) = -2\) (since \(x \leq -1\)).
Left hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to -1^-} f(x) = \lim_{x \to -1^-} (-2) = -2\).
Right hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to -1^+} f(x) = \lim_{x \to -1^+} 2x = 2(-1) = -2\).
Left hand limit = right hand limit = \(f(-1) = -2\), so f is continuous at \(x = -1\).
Continuity at \(x = 1\):
\(f(1) = 2(1) = 2\) (since \(-1 < x \leq 1\)).
Left hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 1^-} 2x = 2\).
Right hand limit: \(\lim_{x \to 1^+} 2 = 2\).
Left hand limit = right hand limit = \(f(1) = 2\), so f is continuous at \(x = 1\).
Hence the function is continuous at both \(x = -1\) and \(x = 1\).

Q6b.hi:
चूँकि \(\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c} = \vec{0}\),
\((\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) \cdot (\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}) = 0\)।
प्रसार करने पर,
\(|\vec{a}|^2 + |\vec{b}|^2 + |\vec{c}|^2 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)।
\(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 2\) रखने पर:
\(9 + 16 + 4 + 2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = 0\)
\(2(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a}) = -29\)
\(\vec{a} \cdot \vec{b} + \vec{b} \cdot \vec{c} + \vec{c} \cdot \vec{a} = -\frac{29}{2}\)।

Q6c.en:
The bubble is a sphere of radius r, so its volume is \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\).
Differentiating with respect to time t,
\(\frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{4}{3}\pi \cdot 3r^2\frac{dr}{dt} = 4\pi r^2\frac{dr}{dt}\).
Given \(\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{1}{2}\) cm/s and \(r = 1\) cm:
\(\frac{dV}{dt} = 4\pi(1)^2 \times \frac{1}{2} = 2\pi\) cm³/s.
So the volume is increasing at the rate of \(2\pi\) cm³/s.
Q6c.hi:
बुलबुला r त्रिज्या का एक गोला है, अतः इसका आयतन \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\) है।
समय t के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर,
\(\frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{4}{3}\pi \cdot 3r^2\frac{dr}{dt} = 4\pi r^2\frac{dr}{dt}\)।
दिया है \(\frac{dr}{dt} = \frac{1}{2}\) cm/s तथा \(r = 1\) cm:
\(\frac{dV}{dt} = 4\pi(1)^2 \times \frac{1}{2} = 2\pi\) cm³/s।
अतः बुलबुले का आयतन \(2\pi\) cm³/s की दर से बढ़ रहा है।

Q6d.en:
Draw the lines of the constraints in the first quadrant (\(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\)).
The line \(x + y = 8\) passes through \((8, 0)\) and \((0, 8)\). The inequality \(x + y \geq 8\) is not satisfied by the origin (\(0 \geq 8\) is false), so its region lies on the side of this line away from the origin.
The line \(3x + 5y = 15\) passes through \((5, 0)\) and \((0, 3)\). The inequality \(3x + 5y \leq 15\) is satisfied by the origin, so its region is the triangle with vertices \((0, 0)\), \((5, 0)\) and \((0, 3)\), on the origin side.
The whole of this triangle lies below the line \(x + y = 8\): for any point in it, \(x + y \leq \frac{3x + 5y}{3} \leq \frac{15}{3} = 5 < 8\). So no point satisfies all the constraints together.
There is no feasible region. Hence \(Z = 3x + 2y\) has no minimum value under the given constraints.
Q6d.hi:
प्रथम चतुर्थांश (\(x \geq 0, y \geq 0\)) में अवरोधों की रेखाएँ खींचिए।
रेखा \(x + y = 8\) बिंदुओं \((8, 0)\) तथा \((0, 8)\) से होकर जाती है। मूल बिंदु असमिका \(x + y \geq 8\) को संतुष्ट नहीं करता (\(0 \geq 8\) असत्य है), अतः इसका क्षेत्र रेखा के उस ओर है जो मूल बिंदु से दूर है।
रेखा \(3x + 5y = 15\) बिंदुओं \((5, 0)\) तथा \((0, 3)\) से होकर जाती है। मूल बिंदु असमिका \(3x + 5y \leq 15\) को संतुष्ट करता है, अतः इसका क्षेत्र शीर्षों \((0, 0)\), \((5, 0)\) तथा \((0, 3)\) वाला त्रिभुज है, जो मूल बिंदु की ओर है।
यह पूरा त्रिभुज रेखा \(x + y = 8\) के नीचे है: इसके किसी भी बिंदु के लिए \(x + y \leq \frac{3x + 5y}{3} \leq \frac{15}{3} = 5 < 8\)। अतः कोई भी बिंदु सभी अवरोधों को एक साथ संतुष्ट नहीं करता।
कोई सुसंगत क्षेत्र नहीं है। अतः दिए गए अवरोधों के अन्तर्गत \(Z = 3x + 2y\) का कोई न्यूनतम मान नहीं है।

Q6e.en:
The three students work independently. The probabilities that they do NOT solve the question are
student A: \(1 - \frac{3}{10} = \frac{7}{10}\), student B: \(1 - \frac{1}{5} = \frac{4}{5}\), student C: \(1 - \frac{1}{10} = \frac{9}{10}\).
P(none of them solves it) \(= \frac{7}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{9}{10} = \frac{252}{500} = \frac{63}{125}\).
The question is solved if at least one of them solves it, so
P(question is solved) \(= 1 - \frac{63}{125} = \frac{62}{125}\).
Q6e.hi:
तीनों छात्र स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रश्न हल करते हैं। प्रश्न हल न कर पाने की प्रायिकताएँ हैं:
छात्र A: \(1 - \frac{3}{10} = \frac{7}{10}\), छात्र B: \(1 - \frac{1}{5} = \frac{4}{5}\), छात्र C: \(1 - \frac{1}{10} = \frac{9}{10}\)।
कोई भी छात्र प्रश्न हल न करे, इसकी प्रायिकता \(= \frac{7}{10} \times \frac{4}{5} \times \frac{9}{10} = \frac{252}{500} = \frac{63}{125}\)।
प्रश्न हल हो जाएगा यदि कम से कम एक छात्र उसे हल कर ले, अतः
प्रश्न के हल हो जाने की प्रायिकता \(= 1 - \frac{63}{125} = \frac{62}{125}\)।

Q7a.en:
\(|A| = 2(1 \cdot 3 - 0 \cdot 1) - 0(5 \cdot 3 - 0 \cdot 0) + (-1)(5 \cdot 1 - 1 \cdot 0) = 6 - 0 - 5 = 1 \neq 0\), so \(A^{-1}\) exists.
Cofactors \(A_{ij}\):
\(A_{11} = 3\), \(A_{12} = -(15 - 0) = -15\), \(A_{13} = 5 - 0 = 5\)
\(A_{21} = -(0 + 1) = -1\), \(A_{22} = 6 - 0 = 6\), \(A_{23} = -(2 - 0) = -2\)
\(A_{31} = 0 + 1 = 1\), \(A_{32} = -(0 + 5) = -5\), \(A_{33} = 2 - 0 = 2\)
The adjoint is the transpose of the matrix of cofactors:
\(\operatorname{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -1 & 1 \\ -15 & 6 & -5 \\ 5 & -2 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\).
So \(A^{-1} = \frac{1}{|A|}\operatorname{adj} A = \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -1 & 1 \\ -15 & 6 & -5 \\ 5 & -2 & 2 \end{bmatrix}\).
Check: the first row of A times the columns of \(A^{-1}\) gives \(6 - 5 = 1\), \(-2 + 2 = 0\), \(2 - 2 = 0\), and likewise the other rows give \(AA^{-1} = I\).

Q8a.en:
Let l be the given slant height, h the height, r the radius of the base and \(\theta\) the semi-vertical angle of the cone. Then \(r^2 = l^2 - h^2\).
Volume: \(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi(l^2 - h^2)h = \frac{\pi}{3}(l^2 h - h^3)\).
Differentiating with respect to h (l is constant):
\(\frac{dV}{dh} = \frac{\pi}{3}(l^2 - 3h^2)\).
For maximum or minimum, \(\frac{dV}{dh} = 0\), so \(l^2 = 3h^2\), that is \(h = \frac{l}{\sqrt{3}}\).
\(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-6h) = -2\pi h < 0\) at \(h = \frac{l}{\sqrt{3}}\), so V is maximum there.
At this height, \(r^2 = l^2 - \frac{l^2}{3} = \frac{2l^2}{3}\), so \(r = \frac{\sqrt{2}\,l}{\sqrt{3}}\).
The semi-vertical angle satisfies \(\tan\theta = \frac{r}{h} = \frac{\sqrt{2}\,l/\sqrt{3}}{l/\sqrt{3}} = \sqrt{2}\).
Hence for maximum volume \(\theta = \tan^{-1}(\sqrt{2})\).
Q8a.hi:
माना शंकु की दी गई तिर्यक ऊँचाई l, ऊँचाई h, आधार की त्रिज्या r तथा अर्ध-शीर्ष कोण \(\theta\) है। तब \(r^2 = l^2 - h^2\)।
आयतन: \(V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi(l^2 - h^2)h = \frac{\pi}{3}(l^2 h - h^3)\)।
h के सापेक्ष अवकलन करने पर (l अचर है):
\(\frac{dV}{dh} = \frac{\pi}{3}(l^2 - 3h^2)\)।
महत्तम या न्यूनतम के लिए \(\frac{dV}{dh} = 0\), अतः \(l^2 = 3h^2\), अर्थात् \(h = \frac{l}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
\(h = \frac{l}{\sqrt{3}}\) पर \(\frac{d^2V}{dh^2} = \frac{\pi}{3}(-6h) = -2\pi h < 0\), अतः यहाँ V महत्तम है।
इस ऊँचाई पर \(r^2 = l^2 - \frac{l^2}{3} = \frac{2l^2}{3}\), अतः \(r = \frac{\sqrt{2}\,l}{\sqrt{3}}\)।
अर्ध-शीर्ष कोण के लिए \(\tan\theta = \frac{r}{h} = \frac{\sqrt{2}\,l/\sqrt{3}}{l/\sqrt{3}} = \sqrt{2}\)।
अतः महत्तम आयतन के लिए \(\theta = \tan^{-1}(\sqrt{2})\)।

Q8b.en:
\((x - y)(dx + dy) = dx - dy\).
Put \(x - y = t\). Then \(dx - dy = dt\), so \(dy = dx - dt\) and \(dx + dy = 2\,dx - dt\).
The equation becomes \(t(2\,dx - dt) = dt\), that is \(2t\,dx = (1 + t)\,dt\).
Separating the variables: \(2\,dx = \left(\frac{1}{t} + 1\right)dt\).
Integrating: \(2x = \log|t| + t + C\).
Putting back \(t = x - y\): \(2x = \log|x - y| + x - y + C\), that is \(x + y = \log|x - y| + C\).
When \(x = 0\), \(y = -1\): \(0 - 1 = \log|0 + 1| + C = 0 + C\), so \(C = -1\).
The particular solution is \(x + y = \log|x - y| - 1\), that is \(\log|x - y| = x + y + 1\).
Q8b.hi:
\((x - y)(dx + dy) = dx - dy\)।
माना \(x - y = t\)। तब \(dx - dy = dt\), अतः \(dy = dx - dt\) तथा \(dx + dy = 2\,dx - dt\)।
समीकरण हो जाता है \(t(2\,dx - dt) = dt\), अर्थात् \(2t\,dx = (1 + t)\,dt\)।
चरों को पृथक करने पर: \(2\,dx = \left(\frac{1}{t} + 1\right)dt\)।
समाकलन करने पर: \(2x = \log|t| + t + C\)।
\(t = x - y\) पुनः रखने पर: \(2x = \log|x - y| + x - y + C\), अर्थात् \(x + y = \log|x - y| + C\)।
जब \(x = 0\), \(y = -1\): \(0 - 1 = \log|0 + 1| + C = 0 + C\), अतः \(C = -1\)।
अभीष्ट विशिष्ट हल \(x + y = \log|x - y| - 1\) है, अर्थात् \(\log|x - y| = x + y + 1\)।

Q9a.en:
Simplify the integrand using \(\sin 2x = 2\sin x\cos x\) and \(1 + \cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x\):
\(\frac{2 + \sin 2x}{1 + \cos 2x} = \frac{2 + 2\sin x\cos x}{2\cos^2 x} = \sec^2 x + \tan x\).
So \(I = \int e^{x}(\tan x + \sec^2 x)\,dx\).
This is of the form \(\int e^{x}\{f(x) + f'(x)\}\,dx = e^{x}f(x) + C\), with \(f(x) = \tan x\) and \(f'(x) = \sec^2 x\).
Hence \(I = e^{x}\tan x + C\).
Q9a.hi:
\(\sin 2x = 2\sin x\cos x\) तथा \(1 + \cos 2x = 2\cos^2 x\) से समाकल्य को सरल करने पर:
\(\frac{2 + \sin 2x}{1 + \cos 2x} = \frac{2 + 2\sin x\cos x}{2\cos^2 x} = \sec^2 x + \tan x\)।
अतः \(I = \int e^{x}(\tan x + \sec^2 x)\,dx\)।
यह \(\int e^{x}\{f(x) + f'(x)\}\,dx = e^{x}f(x) + C\) के रूप का है, जहाँ \(f(x) = \tan x\) तथा \(f'(x) = \sec^2 x\)।
अतः \(I = e^{x}\tan x + C\)।

Q9b.en:
Factorise the denominator:
\(x^3 - x^2 - x + 1 = x^2(x - 1) - (x - 1) = (x - 1)(x^2 - 1) = (x - 1)^2(x + 1)\).
Resolve into partial fractions:
\(\frac{3x + 5}{(x - 1)^2(x + 1)} = \frac{p}{x - 1} + \frac{q}{(x - 1)^2} + \frac{r}{x + 1}\),
so \(3x + 5 = p(x - 1)(x + 1) + q(x + 1) + r(x - 1)^2\).
Put \(x = 1\): \(8 = 2q\), so \(q = 4\).
Put \(x = -1\): \(2 = 4r\), so \(r = \frac{1}{2}\).
Compare coefficients of \(x^2\): \(0 = p + r\), so \(p = -\frac{1}{2}\). (Constant term check: \(-p + q + r = \frac{1}{2} + 4 + \frac{1}{2} = 5\).)
Therefore
\(\int \frac{(3x + 5)\,dx}{x^3 - x^2 - x + 1} = -\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{dx}{x - 1} + 4\int \frac{dx}{(x - 1)^2} + \frac{1}{2}\int \frac{dx}{x + 1}\)
\(= -\frac{1}{2}\log|x - 1| - \frac{4}{x - 1} + \frac{1}{2}\log|x + 1| + C\)
\(= \frac{1}{2}\log\left|\frac{x + 1}{x - 1}\right| - \frac{4}{x - 1} + C\).
